register_nuimages_train: import the nuimages module to register the nuimages_train COCO dataset split with detectron2
register_nuimages_val: import the nuimages module to register the nuimages_val COCO dataset split with detectron2
register_nuimages_mini: import the nuimages module to register the nuimages_mini COCO dataset split with detectron2
get_builtin_metadata: call _get_builtin_metadata to retrieve the nuImages thing classes and ID mapping metadata dictionary
review_categories: review the nuImages categories list containing 10 object classes like car, truck, pedestrian, and barrier
